notes: Version 2.38 records PTO 1.5, ENT-Note 1.3 and LC-Synthesis 2.2. PTO now separates cumulative span retention (immediate), exact stepwise monotonicity of the cumulative projected capacity (conjectural), the reported numerical bound, which holds only within a relative tolerance of 1e-6 after burn-in, and an order on states, which requires the unestablished acyclicity hypothesis [H-acyc]; the first transition is not guaranteed. Two numerical reproducibility gaps are stated. ENT-Note and LC-Synthesis carry the same reading of the PTO input. The PTO, ENT-Note and LC-Synthesis entries, table rows, bibliography note and graph node carry the new versions.
